Then \(\alpha\beta=\dfrac{(\alpha+\beta)^2-(\alpha-\beta)^2}{4}=\dfrac{(3i)^2-11}{4}=\dfrac{-9-11}{4}=-5\).
Now \(\beta^3-\alpha^3=(\beta-\alpha)\big((\alpha+\beta)^2-\alpha\beta\big)=\sqrt{11}\,(-9+5)=-4\sqrt{11}\).
Hence \((\beta^3-\alpha^3)^2=16\times 11=176\).
